title: Observability did not cover GenAI calls incl multimodal (no gen_ai spans/attrs)

rcca.root_cause: otel mapped generic events only; no GenAI semantic-convention attributes and no media-call spans; emitted token counts were redacted as false-positive secrets.
rcca.corrective: otel gen_ai_attributes + spans reader; events gen_ai_call; llm_client/generator_adapters emit counts-only spans; API /api/v1/otel/spans; log_router keeps numeric token counts (secrets still redacted).
rcca.preventive: No prompt/media content logged (counts/ids only); secret redaction preserved; export flag-gated; single event stream.
rcca.fixed_where: core/otel.py; core/events.py; core/orchestrator/llm_client.py; core/generator_adapters.py; core/log_router.py; dashboard/api/app.py; test-framework/tests/pipeline/test_otel_genai.py
